open_questions.text: Should templates for the College's twelve most used forms be included, and in what format are they?
What format are the signed records held in the current tool, and what is the expected volume for migration by 2027-02-28?
What infrastructure and licensing assumptions apply to the optional on-premises deployment option?
Should the one-hour response time for severity-one incidents apply 24/7, and through what communication channel?
What is the expected data volume and schema format for the signed records held in the current tool that need to be migrated by 2027-02-28?
Are there specific rate limits or concurrent connection caps enforced by the College's existing REST API for student records integration?

approach.text: Bid compliance: assemble the proposal as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages and submit it through the College's procurement portal by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC.
approach.basis: The instructions fix the format, page limit, and deadline. The submission timing is an assumption.

approach.text: Signature platform: support signing on current desktop and mobile browsers, keep an audit record of every signature event including signer identity, time, and document version, and store signed documents for ten (10) years.
approach.basis: Browser support, audit components, and the 10-year retention period are stated. The storage location is an assumption.

approach.text: Reminders and integrations: send a reminder to each signer who has not signed within 72 hours, and integrate with the College's student records system through its existing REST API.
approach.basis: The 72-hour reminder and REST API integration requirement are specified. API credentials are an assumption.

approach.text: Availability and go-live: ensure the service is live for students by 2027-01-11, the first day of spring enrollment, and maintain 99.5% availability in each calendar month excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance.
approach.basis: The go-live date and 99.5% availability metric are stated. Maintenance scheduling details are an assumption.

risks.condition: The proposal must be submitted through the College's procurement portal as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC under REQ-0001.
risks.event: The final assembled proposal draft exceeds 20 pages during final formatting or the upload process starts too late to finish before the portal closes.
risks.effect: The tender is rejected without evaluation, leading to immediate disqualification from the bid.
assumptions: The proposal draft will stay under 20 pages without active page budgeting.
risks.trigger: The draft document reaches 18 pages before final annexes are attached.
responses: Enforce a strict 18-page limit on draft sections immediately.
Upload a working draft to the procurement portal 24 hours prior to the 2026-12-01 deadline.
risks.residual_exposure: A portal outage on the submission deadline remains a risk even after an early upload.

risks.condition: Migration of signed records held in the current tool is scheduled for completion by 2027-02-28 under REQ-0007, which falls after the 2027-01-11 student go-live date under REQ-0012.
risks.event: Active student record lookups during spring enrollment require historical data that has not yet been migrated to the new tool.
risks.effect: Staff and students must check two separate systems for records, leading to retrieval errors and compliance breaches.
assumptions: Users will accept searching across both legacy and new systems during the interim migration window.
risks.trigger: Migration script testing reveals data format mismatches with the legacy tool.
responses: Prioritize migration of active student cohorts before the 2027-01-11 go-live date.
Implement a unified search interface bridging the new service and the current tool before go-live.
risks.residual_exposure: A 48-day operational gap where historical records reside outside the primary platform.
